description: A financial account used internally by a bank to manage the line of credit granted to financing requesting party.

accountName.description: The account name, expressed as text, of this financing financial account.

bBANId.description: The unique Basic Bank Account Number (BBAN) identifier used as part of a National Account Numbering Scheme for this financing financial account.

cashAccountTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of financing financial account.

financingFinancialAccountCurrencyCode.description: The code specifying the currency of this financing financial account.

iBANId.description: The unique International Bank Account Number (IBAN) identifier for this financing financial account.

proprietaryId.description: The proprietary identifier for this financing financial account.

proprietaryType.description: The proprietary type, expressed as text, of this financing financial account, such as the nature or use.

uPICId.description: The unique Universal Payment Identification Code (UPIC) identifier used by the New York Clearing House for this financing financial account.
